about: The executable leaves for the drawer convention on inspection's typed sheets: Back keeps the draft, Clear empties it. Format: docs/design-workflow/scenarios.md. Run: node scripts/run-scenarios.mjs inspection

tree.label: A typed sheet (pen note, report fault, resolve fault, selected pens note, filters) → Back → reopen → Clear

children.label: Unit walk, pen C2 open (no pen note)
open Pen note
Pen note opens untouched: no Clear

gwt.given: A worker on the unit walk has pen C2 open; C2 has no pen note.
gwt.then: Pen note opens as before, with Back and its commit in the footer and no Clear, because nothing has been entered.

authority.says: empty what was entered or ticked …; present only while there is something to empty

visible.says: no Clear on an untouched sheet

children.label: type "Gate latch loose"
typing shows Clear in the footer

gwt.given: Pen note is open and empty of edits.
gwt.then: Clear appears in the footer, left of the commit.

authority.says: Clear empties what was entered or ticked … present only when there is something to reset or clear

children.label: Back (footer)
Back leaves Pen note and keeps the typed draft; nothing saved

gwt.given: Pen note holds "Gate latch loose", not saved.
gwt.then: They are back where they came from, the typed text is kept as a draft and nothing is saved.

authority.says: Back … leaves and returns to where you came from, keeping the draft.

children.label: reopen Pen note
reopening Pen note shows the draft, with Clear

gwt.given: They left Pen note with Back while it held "Gate latch loose".
gwt.then: The field still holds "Gate latch loose" and Clear is in the footer.

authority.says: Back … leaves and returns to where you came from, keeping the draft.

children.label: Clear
Clear empties Pen note and goes; nothing saved

gwt.given: Pen note was reopened holding the kept draft "Gate latch loose".
gwt.then: The field is back as it opened, Clear disappears and nothing is saved.

authority.says: Clear empties what was entered or ticked … present only when there is something to reset or clear

record.says: the field is as it opened and no draft is kept

children.label: Back, then reopen
after Clear, Back and reopen show Pen note as it opened

gwt.given: They cleared the draft on Pen note.
gwt.when: They go Back and open it again.
gwt.then: It opens as it did the first time, with no Clear.

authority.says: Clear empties what was entered or ticked … present only when there is something to reset or clear

record.says: the field is as it opened

children.label: the phone's Back
the phone's Back keeps the draft like the footer Back

gwt.given: Pen note holds "Gate latch loose", not saved.
gwt.when: They press the phone's own Back.
gwt.then: They are back where they came from and the typed text is kept as a draft.

authority.says: Back … leaves and returns to where you came from, keeping the draft.
Swiping down or tapping the scrim does what Back does.

children.label: Unit walk, no filter applied, Filter pigs open
pick Care · Monitor, Back
Back from Filter pigs applies nothing and keeps the pick as a draft

gwt.given: A worker on an unfiltered walk opened Filter pigs and picked Care · Monitor without showing pigs.
gwt.then: The walk list is unfiltered, and the pick is kept as a draft.

authority.says: Back … leaves and returns to where you came from, keeping the draft.
In a multi picker Back closes without applying, and the ticks wait as a draft for the next open.

children.label: reopen Filter pigs
reopening Filter pigs shows the kept pick; Reset still restores the defaults

gwt.given: The worker left Filter pigs with Back after picking Care · Monitor.
gwt.then: Care still reads Monitor, waiting to be shown.

authority.says: Back … leaves and returns to where you came from, keeping the draft.
